secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google AI Studio Gemini API key — get it from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role secret key — find it in your Supabase project Dashboard > Settings > API > service_role key

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (e.g. https://xxxx.supabase.co) — from Supabase Dashboard > Settings > API

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable key — from Supabase Dashboard > Settings > API > anon/publishable key

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL for the frontend (same as SUPABASE_URL) — from Supabase Dashboard > Settings > API

secrets.name: QZ_CERTIFICATE
secrets.description: QZ Tray signing certificate (PEM string) — generated via QZ Tray tools, used for signed production print requests

secrets.name: QZ_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: QZ Tray signing private key (PEM string) — generated via QZ Tray tools, server-side only, never expose to frontend
